title: PlanMessage
description: Mind to Body, on geldar.<shard>.body.<life_id>.plan: one validated thought as a plan. The Body checks life_id, body_generation, source_snapshot_id/snapshot_revision and expires_tick (decision 0025) and answers with a PlanAck. action_ids carry one pre-assigned ac_ id per entry of thought.actions, in order, so a redelivery dedups; intent_id is set when thought.intent is present.

expires_tick.description: World age after which the Body refuses the plan.
